description: This file defines themes and color schemes for a terminal UI, including palette selection based on background lightness, syntax highlighting, and theme components for markdown, select lists, and editor UI.

methods.name: channelToSrgb
methods.description: Converts a color channel value to sRGB space for luminance calculations.

methods.name: relativeLuminanceRgb
methods.description: Calculates relative luminance of an RGB color.

methods.name: relativeLuminanceHex
methods.description: Calculates relative luminance from a hex color string.

methods.name: contrastRatio
methods.description: Computes contrast ratio between background and foreground color.

methods.name: pickHigherContrastText
methods.description: Determines if higher contrast text should be used based on background color.

methods.name: isLightBackground
methods.description: Detects if terminal background is light based on environment variables.

methods.name: highlightCode
methods.description: Highlights code syntax with optional language detection.
